usage: ratchet.py providers [-h] [--discover] [--check [CHECK]] [--add ID]
                            [--preset PRESET] [--command COMMAND] [--stdin]
                            [--model MODEL] [--company COMPANY]
                            [--for-risk FOR_RISK] [--variant VARIANT]
                            [--prefer-for PREFER_FOR] [--no-check]
                            [--remove ID] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --discover            find installed agent CLIs, test them, add what works
  --check [CHECK]       send a test request to one provider, a reviewer name
                        such as codex-correctness, or all
  --add ID
  --preset PRESET
  --command COMMAND
  --stdin
  --model MODEL
  --company COMPANY
  --for-risk FOR_RISK   comma list of risks it may review (default all)
  --variant VARIANT     thinking level for an opencode provider (default low;
                        none turns the cap off)
  --prefer-for PREFER_FOR
                        comma list of lenses (correctness, standards, both) it
                        reviews before other providers of the same cost when a
                        slot is any-<lens>
  --no-check
  --remove ID
  --json
